evidence.title: Buried in Textual Debt: Context Pruning with Visual Evidence Preservation for MLLM Agents

summary: Researchers propose a technique to reduce textual overhead in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) without losing critical visual context. The approach aims to improve efficiency in AI agents handling complex, real-world tasks.
title: New Method Addresses Context Pruning in Multimodal AI While Preserving Visual Evidence
